## Type of change

## Checklist

- [ ] `make qa` passes locally (`gofmt`, `go vet`, `go build`, `go test -race`)
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated with a new version entry at the top (newest first)
- [ ] Version constant bumped in `cmd/api/main.go` if this ships user-visible change
- [ ] No secrets, tokens, or credentials committed
- [ ] Tests added/updated for the change (regression test if fixing a bug)
